scope: Post-critique paired organization bootstrap, fixed task pools/scores/lists
sampling: Resample organizations with replacement, retain all their historical situations; divide differences by sampled number of situations; calculate R and S as pooled ratios.
point_audit: PASS all four point metrics against decision_taskpool_signals.csv
limits: Shared candidate patents and only four historical years remain. Organization resampling does not resolve cross-organization shared outcomes, identify behavior, or provide future-environment transportability.
